trust_decision.summary: Global-config descriptor GiteeConnectionConfig decides who may list (and use) system-scoped credentials; at the pinned commit it checks Item.CONFIGURE on the Jenkins root (or nothing at all) instead of Jenkins.ADMINISTER, and its form endpoints accept GET.

landing_point.why: The only place that builds a credentials list box (includeMatchingAs ACL.SYSTEM2); the summary says 'incorrect permission check ... enumerating credentials IDs', and this line holds the wrong Item.CONFIGURE check.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP .../GiteeConnectionConfig/testConnection (Stapler validateButton); takes a credential ID plus an arbitrary URL
HTTP .../GiteeConnectionConfig/checkName (Stapler doCheck); oracle on configured connection names
HTTP .../GiteePushTrigger$WebhookEntry$DescriptorImpl/addWebhook; jakarta @POST swapped for Stapler @RequirePOST (CSRF only)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All permission changes are in GiteeConnectionConfig.java; the GiteePushTrigger.java:821 change is an annotation swap for CSRF (fix.diff:166-167), and fix.diff:125 only adds @RequirePOST.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: doTestConnection (GiteeConnectionConfig.java:134) does not 'list' credentials, so a solver focused on enumeration could argue it is a connection tester, not an enumeration route, even though it uses any credential ID against an arbitrary URL.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Job configurers with Item.CONFIGURE must still be able to choose a Gitee connection in the job form; changing that check to ADMINISTER as part of an over-broad fix breaks job configuration for non-admins. Admins must keep the credential dropdown and the Test Connection button (the project tests call doTestConnection directly).

O6_input_shapes: GET vs POST on the same form endpoints (fix adds @RequirePOST)
credential ID passed directly (testConnection apiTokenId) vs listed (fillApiTokenIdItems)
existing connection name passed to fillApiTokenIdItems (includeCurrentValue path, GiteeConnectionConfig.java:163-171)

O7_producer.where: Credential values are resolved in GiteeConnection.getApiToken (src/main/java/com/gitee/jenkins/connection/GiteeConnection.java:120-133) under ACL.SYSTEM2. It is a handler-level lookup, not a schema or serializer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: doCheckApiTokenId could look up the ID under ACL.SYSTEM2 to warn 'credential not found', which would give an unchecked existence oracle for credential IDs
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Jenkins plugins commonly validate that a credential ID resolves, and GiteeConnection.getApiToken already provides that lookup (GiteeConnection.java:120-133)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a job-level doFillApiTokenIdItems or credentials override on the job property that lists system credentials under the Item.CONFIGURE check already used there
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Per-job credential override is a common feature request for connection plugins; a maintainer would copy the global descriptor's list-box code

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a webhook-secret or credential selection doFill on WebhookEntry.DescriptorImpl that reuses includeMatchingAs(ACL.SYSTEM2, Jenkins.get(), ...)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: addWebhook already calls the Gitee API with the connection's token, so a credential picker beside it is a natural addition, at a distance in another package

O9_family: missing/incorrect authorization (CWE-862) on Jenkins form-fill/validation endpoints; credential ID enumeration, plus CSRF

O10_build.toolchain: Maven, Jenkins plugin parent pom 6.2189.v695a_c41f5249 (pom.xml:6-7), JenkinsRule tests
O10_build.project_tests: src/test/java/com/gitee/jenkins/connection/GiteeConnectionConfigTest.java calls doTestConnection against MockServer (lines 129-139); no permission tests for fill/check endpoints at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change Item.CONFIGURE to Jenkins.ADMINISTER in doFillApiTokenIdItems only, leaving doTestConnection (credential ID + arbitrary URL, no check) and GET access open.

out_of_scope_notes: GiteeApiRepoProperty @JavaScriptMethod addRepoOwner/removeRepoOwner/removeAllRepoOwners have no permission check (src/main/java/com/gitee/jenkins/connection/GiteeApiRepoProperty.java:165-185); this is config mutation, a different sink, and not pursued.
The fix also deletes doFillClientBuilderIdItems (fix.diff:97-104); no jelly references clientBuilderId, so it looks like dead-code cleanup.
